text:
maria: Anyone seeing a spike in local NVMe iowait on eu-west-1 batch nodes? GPU provisioning started failing around 09:02 UTC with 'no healthy hosts' for small fleets.
aj: Yep, saw a few pods stuck Pending. kube events initially looked like ImagePullBackOff but iowait on the nodes is through the roof.
maria: Not image related — kernel logs show repeated blk_update_request I/O errors and the ephemeral-cleaner kicked in multiple times.
infra-bot: ALERT: nvme_iops_surge detected on gn-p012 (eu-west-1). iowait 92% -> auto-evict triggered.
kevin: Running quick iostat on gn-p012, paste below.
kevin: ```
Linux 5.15.0-101-generic (gn-p012)  03/10/24
avg-cpu:  %user   %nice %system %iowait  %steal   %idle
           12.5    0.0    10.1    66.7     0.0     10.7
Device            r/s     w/s   rkB/s   wkB/s  avgrq-sz  avgqu-sz  await  svctm  %util
nvme0n1         120.0  3400.0  4096.0  65536.0   18.7     45.3    48.2   0.12  99.9
```
kevin: avgqu-sz and await are brutal; lots of write contention.
ravi: Looks like cleaner + background scrubs are causing write amplification. TRIM-heavy workloads + aggressive cleaner policy -> GC storms on PM1733 drives. We've seen firmware regressions before.
maria: Can we throttle the cleaner? Suggest pausing ephemeral-cleaner for pool-local-eu-west1 and set max_concurrent_cleaners=1 in the configmap as a quick mitigation.
ops-oncall: Pausing cleaner now: `kubectl -n infra patch deployment/ephemeral-cleaner -p '{"spec":{"replicas":0}}'`
ops-oncall: Also added a node taint to prevent new GPU provisioning onto suspect nodes: `kubectl taint nodes gn-p012 no-gpu-provision=true:NoSchedule` (temporary)
kevin: I'm also toggling provisioning fallback. Command applied: `kubectl apply -f /ops/provisioning/fallback-policy.yaml` to route requests to dedicated-reserve when local pool unhealthy.
ravi: Long term: schedule firmware patch for affected nodes (PM1733 batch) and bump scrub backoff. Filing a follow-up tonight for a controlled rollout.
maria: Quick note on cost/availability impact: several small GPU jobs retried and fell back to higher-cost dedicated capacity for ~25 minutes. Finance impact estimate pending. @ops please capture numbers.
aj: Will grab job retry counts and tokenized provisioning failures. I'll assemble a short postmortem with iostat + scrub logs.
ops-oncall: Cleaner paused at 09:07 UTC. gn-p012 iowait dropped to ~14% and provisioning resumed.
infra-bot: INCIDENT CLOSED: nvme-iops-surge-eu-west-1. Mitigations applied (cleaner pause, taint, provisioning fallback). Follow-up: firmware rollout + cleaner config change (max_concurrent_cleaners=1).
